text_to_image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE original fictional adult male character, age 23–27, strikingly handsome with refined youthful romantic-lead appeal, natural charismatic gaze and excellent facial harmony. This must be a new invented person, not a celebrity likeness. Use the individual facial design described below while retaining beauty and subtle natural asymmetry. Clean groomed skin with fine natural pores, no artificial smoothing or exaggerated blemishes, clean-shaven unless specified. A polished yet believable everyday editorial photo, not a passport picture. Vertical 3:4 image, eye-level, head facing forward, direct eye contact, complete hair, both shoulders and half body framed to just above waist, relaxed elegant posture, face prominent. Entire background is flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF, bright soft frontal studio light, low shadow, natural skin texture, slight halation, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with both eyes sharp. No props, text, logos, watermark, other people, collage, cutout, transparency or vignette. South Asian man age 30 with voluminous chestnut waves, light beard stubble, assured thoughtful charm, plain black open-collar shirt. NEW facial design: broad heart-shaped face, high cheekbones, small rounded chin, slim curved eyebrows, dark-brown hooded eyes, straight broad-root nose, full lips with subtle asymmetry. Warm medium-brown skin. No resemblance to a known actor.
